_comment: Commit revisions for every §7 repository the fetcher downloads. `snapshot_download` without `revision=` resolves whatever the branch head points at on the day it runs, so two machines can hold different weights under the same name and every number in evidence/ would be about weights nobody can identify. Keys starting with _ are ignored. D-073.
_measured: 2026-08-09 from huggingface.co via HfApi().model_info(repo).sha. Not guessed and not copied from a model card. Each SHA below was additionally verified against the weights already on hawapc01 by comparing the git blob id of the local config.json with the Hub's blob id for the same path at that revision — all four visual checkpoints MATCHED, so these are the revisions that produced the measurements in evidence/m5-*.md and evidence/m6-*.md.
_pyannote: CORRECTED 2026-08-09 (D-075). This file first omitted pyannote/speaker-diarization-community-1, arguing that pinning a repo nobody here has downloaded would record a number rather than a fact. That was wrong, and a parallel branch pinning it is what prompted the re-check: gating on this repo covers file *downloads*, not metadata. Measured from this machine with no HF_TOKEN — model_info() returns 3533c8cf... and list_repo_files() returns all 10 files, while hf_hub_download('config.yaml') raises GatedRepoError 401. So the revision is a verifiable fact here, and pinning it means that when BLOCKED.md #4 is resolved the download lands on a known commit rather than a head.
